name: SystemPageTemplate
need: No app here has a proper not-found / unavailable / broken page: transcript hand-built one, airun redirects * to the cockpit, the rest have nothing. The GOV.UK triad answers the reader's real questions — what happened, did you keep my answers, what do I do — and each product reinvents that from zero or ships nothing.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: An empty state lives INSIDE a working screen; a system page IS the screen, with its own narrow measure and no chrome assumptions.
The three pages differ in COPY, not structure: one narrow column, the fact as h1, body, contact, one action. The example carries the canonical copy; the block stays copy-free for i18n.

proposedApi.SystemPageTemplate: title (the plain fact — never a code, never Oops), children (the triage or the consequences; 'did you keep my answers' is the failure page's one obligatory sentence), contact, action

sources: GOV.UK page-not-found (a triage script for the three ways users got there), service-unavailable (the date and the fate of the data), problem-with-the-service; USWDS 404 (search as recovery on content products)
decision: Build as a block per the golden-screens G5 batch; the system archetype gains its carrier.
